entity_raw.definition_raw:
Half-drow tap into inner reserves, fighting even more fiercely when losing.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, half-drow.

Benefit(s): When reduced to half of your maximum hit points or fewer, you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases to +2 at 8th level and to +3 at 15th level.
